title: Register vector
statement: For a register state, its register vector is the length-fifteen vector of natural numbers whose entries, in order, are the input length, $\ell$, the radius, the exponent, $K$, the number of runs, the runs remaining, the accepting-run count, the current code, the candidate code, the coins remaining, and the four scratch values.
